claims.claim: A response can acknowledge an emotion while choosing behaviour consistent with values and context. Regulation does not mean suppressing every feeling or always staying calm. In ordinary disagreements, options include asking a clarifying question, expressing a concern, delaying a response with an agreed return time, or seeking support. In unsafe situations, prioritise distance and help rather than conflict skills. The appropriate option depends on urgency, power and safety.
